sanskrit: sarvāṇyetāni yo vetti sa yogaṃ yoktu marhati || 4 ||
harṣaṃ bhayaṃ viṣādaṃ ca satyajan yogamabhyaset || 6 ||
susūkṣmaṃ vyāpakaṃ nityaṃ nirvikalpaṃ sadā budhaḥ || 16 ||
vidyāṃ kalāṃ tataḥ kālaṃ māyāṃ vidyāṃ tataḥ parām || 28 ||
sarveṣveva sa śāstreṣu jñeyaṃ vastu catuṣṭayam || 31 ||
jñātvā tu tatva sadbhāvaṃ tantrasāraṃ tu durlabham || 32 ||
saṃyogaṃ ca tathā teṣāṃ kathayasva maheśvara || 1 ||
kā pāśāḥ komalāḥ proktāḥ kasmādvandhaḥ pumāniti || 2 ||
antarlūnaṃ tathā jñeyaṃ śivatvaṃ pudgalasya tu || 5 ||
āgantukāḥ smṛtāḥ hyete tasmāt sāṃsargikāḥ punaḥ || 14 ||
te tu sāṃsargikāḥ pāśāḥ sukhaduḥkhaphalaḥ pradā || 15 ||
na kasya vijāyākhyātaṃ tadvijñānaṃ śṛṇuṣva me || 2 ||
yaḥ śivaḥ sohameveti advaitaṃ bhāvayet sadā || 13 ||
sthūlo mantramayaḥ proktaḥ sūkṣmo dhyānaika saṃsthitaḥ || 19 ||
sa mucyate tvayatnena sarvāvasthāṃ gatopi san || 25 ||
sarvajñaṃ tu tamātmānaṃ paripūrṇaṃ sadā smaret || 27 ||
sa niṣkale pare sthāne tatra cittaṃ niveśayet || 28 ||
ātmasaṃsthaṃ manaḥ kṛtvā na kiñcidapi cintayet || 36 ||
